title: Coils of Rope for the Boatwright
summary: Fulk Brine wants 3 coils of rope from the boat slip taken to Blythe Selby before the boats go out, and then a word.
offer_text: "We need coils of rope, and what is stacked at the boat slip is the town's to take. Carry it to Blythe Selby before the boats go out, then come and tell me."
turn_in_text: "Good. That is one thing in Coldharbor that goes right."

objectives.text: Take 3 coils of rope from the pile
Hand the coils of rope to Blythe Selby
Tell Fulk Brine it is done

relationship.label: Ran an errand for the town
